query.method: GitHub repository PR listing; per-PR base/head SHA comparison and latest PR-triggered workflow run

limitations: CI records are latest PR-triggered workflow runs returned by the GitHub API, not all required checks or branch-protection decisions.
Protected artifact paths are identified, but exact content hashes were not fetched for every changed protected file.
PR metadata and compare results are a point-in-time snapshot; branch tips can advance after capture.
